explicit_validation.explanation: The paper explicitly validates LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o and QWEN 2.5 72B) against human evaluations on a gold standard of 1,000 annotated model translations, reporting accuracy and macro F1 scores for comparison.

prompts.notes: Full evaluation prompt for English-Greek provided verbatim in the text; other language prompts are available from the original data release cited as 'Comandini 2024'. Prompts include exemplar annotations and detailed scoring rubrics.

guidelines.notes: Comprehensive binary annotation guidelines available in project repository; human evaluators were native speakers following detailed guidelines for neutrality assessment.

sample_size.notes: Gold standard of 1,000 annotated model translations used for validation, consisting of 50 Set-G and 50 Set-N outputs from each of five models per language pair.

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4o achieves 92% accuracy and 0.87 macro F1 versus human judgments, outperforming QWEN 2.5 72B (85% accuracy, 0.80 macro F1), establishing GPT-4o as a reliable judge for gender neutrality.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluation focus on binary neutrality classification (Gendered/Neutral).
